limitations: 20 section observations, 18 unique game URLs, five unique detail inspections. Bounded nonrandom sample. Bloxd.io and Boxity.io occur in both sections; duplicate section exposures are retained without adding their metrics together.
Homepage US label is not a global ranking; DOM positions are not official ranks.
Hot monthly title conflicts with last-24-hours introduction; no inferred unified window.

Unobserved and uncollected metrics are null. Rating, likes, dislikes, plays and active users are different metrics. Tag counts are directory sizes. No game-level plays or active users observed, and no old observations copied.

Twenty cover representations were freshly downloaded locally and fully decoded, with MIME inferred from decoded format, size and SHA-256 verified. Supported browser APIs expose neither HTTP status nor response Content-Type, so all twenty cover records remain verification_incomplete with null repository paths, hashes and successful-fetch metadata. Six candidate hashes are new and fourteen were previously present, but no candidate image is eligible for this publication and no existing image is claimed as fully verified this run.
Chinese descriptions generated from five current detail pages and reused only for same-run repeated identities; 14 section records lack sufficient gameplay evidence and have null descriptions.
Header/body release-date conflicts are preserved. Page dates retain source precision.
No hidden API, manual gameplay, votes or video download. Embedded games may auto-load. Source image rights remain with owners; no redistribution license asserted.
